description: Plans a new Uniswap v4 pool for a token on LoomDesk's open hook (LoomOpenHookV2), where nine tenths of the swap fee go to the liquidity and a tenth to the LoomDesk book, taken in the quote. Use when ladder_pools shows no pool of the token against the quote wanted, or none that pays liquidity; when a position is wanted in it right away, prefer plan_build, which opens the pool and builds in one transaction. Returns: transactions[] (to, data, value in wei, gas), check (simulated, ok, failedStep, reason, ethNeeded, ethHeld), sendWithin, ifItReverts, slippagePct, the pool's key and opening price, then (the key and price for plan_ladder with newPool). The pool opens at the price of the token's existing market and holds nothing until liquidity is added; one-off cost about a dollar. Behavior: read-only on our side; nothing is signed or sent. The plan is laid out from the chain at this block and simulated from the owner; send it within check.sendWithin, and plan again rather than resend one that reverted. Costs quota units (agent_quota). Errors: refused when the pair already has a pool on the hook, the quote has no exit (under 2,000 USDG of liquidity on the chain), or the token has no market to price from.

feePct.description: The pool's swap fee in percent: 0.1 (rungs from 0.01% wide), 0.5 (from 0.1%), or 1 to 5 (from 2%); a full-range pool takes 1 to 5. Left out: the preset's, else 1.

hook.description: Which hook the pool goes on and with what, when it has to be opened. Left out: the plain ranges pool at feePct; the answer then lists the presets under options. A full-range pool, a launch fee or the volatility fee are opened by the hook's own call in a transaction before the build (plan_build returns both, in order).

blocks.description: ranges only: the creator's blocks, each enforced by the hook in every swap and fixed at opening. A trader always pays the pool's fee and no more: the royalty and the burn come out of it.

antiSnipeMaxQuote.description: Anti-snipe: the most a single buy may spend of the quote (ETH or USDG, in whole units) during the first antiSnipeMinutes.

burnPct.description: Auto burn: this percent of the base fee is burned in the token on every sell. At most 20.

managedFee.description: Managed fee: the creator may later move the base fee between these tiers (same spacing as the fee: 1 to 5 together), an hour apart, with the hook's setFee.

offHoursFeePct.description: Market hours: outside NYSE hours (weekdays 13:30 to 20:00 UTC) the base fee is this tier instead.

royaltyPct.description: Royalty: this percent of the base fee goes to the pool's creator in the quote, every swap. At most 30.

kind.description: ranges: LoomOpenHookV2, any band, the fee in the asset paid in (default). full: LoomFullHook, one full-range position only, every fee in the quote (ETH or USDG), and a swap that closes a gap of 3%+ to the token's Uniswap v3 market pays for the gap instead.

launchFeePct.description: The fee the pool opens at, percent, above the swap fee and at most 50; it falls in a straight line to the swap fee over launchMinutes. Needs launchMinutes.

launchMinutes.description: How long the launch fee takes to fall to the swap fee: 1 to 1440 minutes.

preset.description: A named set: steady (1%, plain), volatile (3%, volatility fee on), launch (5%, opens at 50% and falls to 5% over an hour, volatility fee on), full (full range, 1% in the quote, opens at 10% for ten minutes). A field given beside it wins.

volatility.description: ranges only: a fee that rises for a while after the price moves (a move under 3% adds nothing; the add fades within minutes).

owner.description: The wallet that signs, sends, and pays the opening cost.

quote.description: What the token trades against: ETH, USDG, or a quote token's address (a tokenized stock, LOOM, any token with a real exit).

startMarketCapUsd.description: For a token that has never traded (not in the index): the market cap the pool opens at, in dollars; the price is it over the token's supply. Ignored for a token with a market.

startPriceUsd.description: For a token that has never traded: the price the pool opens at, in dollars per token, instead of startMarketCapUsd.
